contentText: The head of the UN's nuclear watchdog said on March 2nd his agency has "no indication" that any nuclear installations have been damaged or hit in Iran following US and Israeli strikes on the country. These nuclear bases have been a focus point for the past few months now. "If the US wanted to act on the Iranian nuclear programme, it should have acted in 2001", Sina Azodi, Director of the Middle East studies program at George Washington University, tells FRANCE 24.
